title: Settlement Timing Extra on the Replacement Haul-Away Credit
content:
**Rule.** On the replacement haul-away credit of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, an extra percentage is set by the timing of the customer's most recent claim settlement on the records of Northgate Protect Protection Plans (administered by Keystone Protection Services) (where two share the most recent date, the one recorded first), counted in calendar days from the settlement date to the order date, the settlement date left out and the order date included:

| Settlement falls before the order date by | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| zero to thirty days | 40 percent |
| thirty-one to sixty days | 20 percent |
| sixty-one to ninety days | nothing |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).** Thirty days adds 40 percent and thirty-one adds 20 percent; sixty days adds 20 percent and sixty-one adds nothing.
